refuerzo_pico: PICOC[P: aguas residuales/comunidad; I: WBE con muestreo repetido; C: vs vigilancia clinica; O: tendencias temporales; C: vigilancia poblacional continua] — "Build up trends if survey is done repeatedly" (Sims_2020, p.3)

PICOC[P: poblacion conectada al alcantarillado; I: analisis de aguas residuales agregadas; C: vs vigilancia clinica; O: deteccion de presencia y brotes; C: escala comunitaria en tiempo real] — "WBE postulates that through the analysis of population pooled wastewater, infectious disease and resistance spread, the emergence of new disease outbreak to the community level can be monitored comprehensively and in real-time." (Sims_2020, p.2)

PICOC[P: SARS-CoV-2 en aguas residuales del DMQ; I: secuenciacion Oxford Nanopore + Freyja; C: vs vigilancia clinica hospitalaria; O: asignacion de linajes; C: antecedente local Quitumbe 2023-2024] — "multiplex PCR was used for sequencing with Oxford Nanopore Technology. Bioinformatic analysis was conducted using Freyja. Results: A predominance of the Omicron variant was observed, with lineages such as HN.1, EG.5.1.6, XBB.1.5.1.5, and HV.1 detected." (MejiaCalle_2024, p.10)

PICOC[P: influente de la PTAR Quitumbe; I: muestreo del influente; C: —; O: caracterizacion del sitio centinela; C: DMQ, caudal urbano] — "week in the incoming wastewater at the Quitumbe WWTP, where the flow rate is 75 L/s." (MejiaCalle_2024, p.32)

PICOC[P: ARN de SARS-CoV-2 en aguas residuales; I: muestreo pasivo con medio adsorbente (gasa); C: vs muestreo activo/puntual; O: muestra integrada; C: sitio centinela] — "Passive sampling for SARS-CoV-2 RNA, which generally employs simple adsorption media (e.g., a classic Moore swab, using cotton, gauze, or tampons), is often less expensive and simpler to use for the actual sampler deployment component of the workflow" (Parkins_2023, p.9)

PICOC[P: analito viral en aguas residuales; I: muestreo pasivo; C: vs muestreo puntual (grab); O: menor limite de deteccion y mayor sensibilidad; C: aplicacion centinela] — "Since they also concentrate the target analyte, they can effectively achieve a lower detection limit and better sensitivity than a grab sample (124), which can be appropriate for sentinel applications where the switch from non-detectable to detectable is the key monitoring objective" (Parkins_2023, p.10)

PICOC[P: poliovirus (PV1) en aguas residuales; I: concentracion secundaria por PEG/NaCl; C: entre cinco metodos de concentracion; O: recuperacion de PV1; C: vigilancia ambiental de virus entericos] — "Of the five tested methods, PEG/NaCl precipitation and skimmed-milk flocculation resulted in the highest PV1 recoveries." (Falman_2019, p.1)

PICOC[P: virus en el pellet de aguas residuales; I: preconcentracion con solucion 2X PEG/NaCl; C: —; O: concentracion viral previa a extraccion; C: protocolo local Quitumbe] — "by preparing a 2X PEG solution, following the protocol by Woods and Jones (2021), in this protocol, 20g of PEG and 3.48g of NaCl are added to a BOECO flask" (MejiaCalle_2024, p.33)

PICOC[P: ARN viral en aguas residuales; I: preconcentracion PEG previa a extraccion con kit Quick-RNA Viral (Zymo); C: con vs sin PEG; O: recuperacion y deteccion del ARN viral; C: matriz ambiental] — "PEG pre-concentration method improves the recovery and detection of viral RNA from wastewater." (MejiaCalle_2024, p.39)

PICOC[P: SARS-CoV-2 en aguas residuales; I: RT-qPCR de blancos N (nucleocapside) del panel CDC; C: entre ensayos; O: deteccion molecular; C: vigilancia ambiental amplia] — "especially CDC N1, N2 and N3, and E_Sarbeco have been used to detect SARS-CoV-2 in wastewater samples from the Netherlands" (Ahmed_2020, p.7)

PICOC[P: SARS-CoV-2 y otros patogenos en aguas residuales; I: secuenciacion por amplicones solapados (tiled-PCR); C: vs enriquecimiento por hibridacion y metagenomica; O: mayor cobertura de genoma a baja carga; C: matriz ambiental degradada] — "Tiled-PCR sequencing led to further improvements in genome coverage compared to hybrid capture for severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2, enterovirus D68, norovirus GII, and human adenovirus F41 in wastewater samples." (Child_2023, p.1)

PICOC[P: poliovirus en heces y muestras ambientales; I: PCR anidada de VP1 + secuenciacion Nanopore (DDNS); C: vs cultivo celular; O: secuencia VP1 completa en dias; C: confirmacion rapida] — "(DDNS) of a nested VP1 PCR product direct from stool samples, observing a sensitivity of 88% to 99% across serotypes when compared to cell culture" (Shaw_2022, p.2)

PICOC[P: poliovirus ambientales; I: secuenciacion de la region VP1 e ITD; C: entre cepas Sabin/derivadas; O: diferenciacion y clasificacion de cepas; C: pais con IPV] — "Sequencing the complete viral protein 1 (VP1) capsid coding region, as well as intratypic differentiation (ITD), identified 3 Sabin type 1, 13 Sabin type 2, and 4 Sabin type 3 strains." (Zurbriggen_2008, p.1)

PICOC[P: enterovirus/poliovirus; I: primera ronda de PCR anidada con cebadores pan-enterovirus (5'NCR/Cre); C: —; O: amplificacion del capside previo a VP1; C: protocolo DDNS] — "capsid RT-PCR with Cre-R and 5'NCR primers in an RT-PCR, followed by pan-PV PCR using Q8/Y7 VP1 primers (Data Set S1)." (Shaw_2020, p.6)

PICOC[P: poliovirus; I: segunda ronda de VP1 con cebadores Q8/Y7 modificados con codigos de barras; C: —; O: multiplexado y simplificacion de bibliotecas; C: secuenciacion Nanopore] — "we sought to reduce the time and cost for nanopore sequencing library preparation by modifying these primers with either the addition of a barcode adaptor (VP1-BCA) or barcode (VP1-barcode) to allow immediate multiplexing of samples" (Shaw_2020, p.3)

PICOC[P: poliovirus en muestras de heces y ambientales; I: deteccion molecular directa por PCR anidada + Nanopore; C: vs aislamiento en cultivo celular; O: reduccion de tiempos de confirmacion; C: vigilancia ambiental] — "We present a nested PCR and nanopore sequencing protocol that allows rapid (<3 days) and sensitive direct detection and sequencing of polioviruses in stool and environmental samples." (Shaw_2020, p.1)

PICOC[P: RSV en muestras clinicas y ambientales; I: amplicones solapados + secuenciacion Nanopore; C: vs esquemas de amplicon largo/hibridacion; O: genomas completos con cargas variables; C: vigilancia clinica y ambiental] — "we developed a short amplicon RSV sequencing protocol using nanopore sequencing that is effective for both patient samples as well as wastewater surveillance." (Le_2025, p.2)

PICOC[P: subgrupos RSV-A y RSV-B; I: esquema de cebadores pan-subtipo con referencia adecuada; C: entre subtipos/clados; O: evitar perdida de lecturas en el mapeo; C: diversidad de subgrupos] — "evident that the use of an incorrect RSV subtype as a reference in the ARTIC pipeline significantly reduced read" (Le_2025, p.3)

PICOC[P: productos de amplicones (ARTIC/VarSkip); I: electroforesis en gel de agarosa; C: —; O: verificacion de amplificacion exitosa; C: control de calidad pre-secuenciacion] — "for successful amplification by agarose gel electrophoresis. PCR products for samples" (Child_2023, p.15)

PICOC[P: virus a baja concentracion en aguas residuales; I: seleccion/descarte de muestras con baja amplificacion; C: metodo dirigido vs no dirigido; O: recuperacion de informacion genomica util; C: baja carga viral] — "untargeted shotgun sequencing was unsuitable for genomic monitoring of the low virus concentrations in wastewater samples analyzed in this study." (Child_2023, p.1)

PICOC[P: amplicones de ADN; I: preparacion de bibliotecas ONT (end-repair, barcoding, limpieza); C: —; O: bibliotecas para secuenciacion; C: flujo de amplicones] — "library preparation (addition of a purification step between the end-preparation and the barcoding reactions, adaptation of elution volumes to maximize recovery)." (Barbe_2022, p.4)

PICOC[P: bibliotecas multiplexadas; I: secuenciacion en plataformas ONT (MinION/GridION/PromethION); C: entre dispositivos por rendimiento; O: secuenciacion en tiempo real; C: laboratorio centralizado o portatil] — "Devices capable of yielding higher throughputs than the MinION device, namely the GridION and the PromethION, are also available on the market." (Dash_2024, p.110)

PICOC[P: amplicones de VP1 de poliovirus; I: preparacion de bibliotecas segun protocolo DDNS; C: —; O: secuenciacion multiplexada portatil; C: MinION] — "we have developed a nested PCR with time- and cost-saving barcoded primers that allows multiplex sample sequencing on a portable MinION sequencer." (Shaw_2020, p.12)

PICOC[P: RSV (genoma completo) y poliovirus (VP1); I: flujos automatizados de tipificacion por amplicones; C: entre virus/regiones diana; O: caracterizacion genomica; C: secuenciacion ONT] — "in this study offers a complete package to sequence RSV with an amplicon-based tiling approach using ONT." (Le_2025, p.6)

PICOC[P: lecturas de secuenciacion en matriz ambiental; I: control de calidad estricto; C: nanoporos vs otras plataformas NGS; O: manejo de la tasa de error; C: complejidad de aguas residuales] — "One drawback of nanopore sequencing is its relatively high error rate." (Dash_2024, p.364)

PICOC[P: reaccion de PCR/ensayo viral; I: inclusion de controles positivos (sembrado) y negativos; C: control + vs control -; O: verificacion del desempeno; C: validacion metodologica] — "each assay included unseeded primary concentrate as a negative control and experiments were seeded with PV1 at least an order of" (Falman_2019, p.9)

PICOC[P: SARS-CoV-2 y otros virus en aguas residuales; I: interpretacion de Cq tardio con menor peso; C: —; O: amplificacion/secuenciacion comprometida; C: baja carga, inhibidores y ARN degradado] — "Recovery of replication-competent viruses from wastewater is particularly challenging owing to rapid degradation over time, inhibitory chemicals in the wastewater matrix" (Parkins_2023, p.19)

PICOC[P: poblacion grande en aguas residuales a escala poblacional; I: analisis WBE con fines de salud publica; C: —; O: evaluacion bioetica sin objeciones mayores; C: cuatro principios de la bioetica] — "Their analysis considered the principles of respect for autonomy, nonmaleficence (avoidance of harm or risk for participants), beneficence (benefits outweigh risks), and distributive justice (no groups are singled out)" (Subedi_2019, p.19)

PICOC[P: poblaciones pequenas o sensibles; I: muestreo de aguas residuales; C: vs poblacion grande; O: riesgo de estigmatizacion del grupo; C: prisiones, trabajos, escuelas] — "they cautioned the use of wastewater sampling on small or sensitive populations, such as prisons, places of work, and schools, where indirect harms, such as illicit drug use by some, could instigate policy measures that negatively affect the entire group." (Subedi_2019, p.19)

PICOC[P: material potencialmente infeccioso (SARS-CoV-2) en aguas residuales; I: procesamiento con practicas de bioseguridad; C: —; O: contencion del riesgo de manejo; C: requerimiento de instalacion BSL-3] — "None of the reported studies to date have provided information on the percent recovery of SARS-CoV-2 from wastewater due to the risk associated with handling SARS-CoV-2 and the requirements for a BSL-3 facility." (Ahmed_2020, p.7)
